content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-21: A red smear hangs above the pine tops after dusk, too high for fireflies and too still for sunset. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.
content.branch_a_path: YY stayed out late to watch the red band fade and carried home a sky-color he could not eat.
content.branch_b_path: YY woke Mira for the red band, and the ledger received its first night entry under his name.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
shared_elements: A red smear hangs above the pine tops after dusk, too high for fireflies and too still for sunset.
Both branches keep the event physical and local.
Neither branch creates a new fork; the day deepens existing patterns.
